goal:
CD-2: Research V1 workflow, trust boundary, and report lifecycle

Define the first end-to-end user workflow: a developer runs Dogwatch in a checkout or CI, produces a report artifact, and an operator views that report in the dashboard. Decide what is stored, how a report identifies its repository/revision, and which GitHub integration belongs in V1.

The key safety constraint is that the web service must not clone arbitrary repositories, execute user commands, or generate an OpenAPI document by importing a user application. CI/local scanner output is the only V1 ingestion path.

h2. Acceptance criteria

* An ADR records the V1 workflow from local/CI scan to dashboard report.
* The ADR defines report provenance: repository identifier, commit SHA, base SHA, scanner version, and scan timestamp.
* The ADR explicitly excludes server-side repository execution, arbitrary clone URLs, live OpenAPI URLs, and application-code generation from V1.
* The ADR decides whether V1 GitHub support is a workflow/action artifact only, rather than a GitHub App integration.
